target_semantics_lesson: Forecast the monthly S&P 500 return for December 2024, considering policy, risk, and earnings.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate policy by agreeing futures/projections, risk by volatility/flows, earnings by revisions, and tech by breadth.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Restrictive policy and geopolitical risk can pressure returns. Broad earnings growth can offset this. The net effect depends on their relative strength.
counterevidence_lesson: Concentrated earnings in 'Magnificent 7' may signal weak breadth, undermining positive return expectations.
calibration_lesson: Test if earnings breadth outweighs policy/risk by comparing estimate revisions with rate futures and volatility.
